culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hajime Yamanashi. He attacked Tomoya while he was using the hand dryer in the bathroom, then used a roll of toilet paper to keep the hand dryer running. The evidence is a button from his jacket that was found in the toilet drain. His motive was that Tomoya indirectly caused his sister Akiho’s death after she unfortunately witnessed a murder and was chased by the murderer.

motive.quote: She was able to run to a police box, but there was no one there since the police officer was with Tomoya, who called them only because he saw a suspicious man outside his house.

motive.zhHans: 她得以跑到派出所，但那里空无一人，因为警员当时和 Tomoya 在一起，而 Tomoya 报警只是因为看到自家屋外有一名可疑男子。最终 Akiho 也遭到杀害，Hajime 在听完 Tomoya 的讲述并得知自己对此负有责任后，决意复仇，于是杀死了 Tomoya。据透露，Shin Kotani 也想用 Hajime 所用的同一手法杀死 Tomoya，因为 Tomoya 导致他被解雇，但他最终没有这么做，而是决定留在餐厅里保持冷静。
motive.en: She was able to run to a police box, but there was no one there since the police officer was with Tomoya, who called them only because he saw a suspicious man outside his house. In the end, Akiho was also murdered, and Hajime, after hearing Tomoya's story and learning that he was responsible, decided to get revenge, so he killed Tomoya. It is revealed that Shin Kotani also wanted to murder Tomoya with the same method that Hajime used because he had caused him to be fired from his job, but he refused to do it and decided to stay calm in the restaurant.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Hajime Yamanashi。他趁 Tomoya 在洗手间使用烘手器时袭击了他，随后用一卷卷纸让烘手器保持运转。证据是他的夹克上掉落在厕所排水口里的一颗纽扣。他的动机是 Tomoya 间接导致了他的妹妹 Akiho 的死亡——Akiho 不幸目击了一起凶杀案并被凶手追赶。
resolution.en: The culprit is Hajime Yamanashi. He attacked Tomoya while he was using the hand dryer in the bathroom, then used a roll of toilet paper to keep the hand dryer running. The evidence is a button from his jacket that was found in the toilet drain. His motive was that Tomoya indirectly caused his sister Akiho’s death after she unfortunately witnessed a murder and was chased by the murderer.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in a restaurant, when they overheard Tomoya Kusano talking about his kindness to his friend Hajime Yamanashi. Conan notice an angry suspicious man in hoodie. Later, Tomoya Kusano is found dead in the toilet.
